en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Khalid Bin Tahmaan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you guffaw (loud bursts of laughter), so say when you are free (from it), ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not Detest me’’.
en.sarwar: 13. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Khalid ibn Tahman from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
If you have laughed loudly, say, ‘O Lord, please, do not hate me.’”
